method.name: articulation_create
method.description: Creates a reduced-coordinate articulation (PhysX [code]PxArticulationReducedCoordinate[/code]) and returns its RID. Configure links, drives and flags, then attach it to a space with [method articulation_set_space]. Links must be added before the articulation joins a space.

method.name: articulation_set_space
method.description: Attaches the articulation to a physics space (or detaches it with an invalid RID). Add all links before calling this; [code]PxArticulationLink[/code]s cannot be created while the articulation is in a scene.

method.name: articulation_add_link
method.description: Adds a link and returns its 0-based index. [param parent_index] -1 creates the base link (world-posed via [param child_frame]; [param joint_type] ignored). Otherwise [param child_frame] is the link pose relative to its parent and [param parent_frame] the inbound joint anchor in the parent link's frame. [param joint_type]: 0 FIX, 1 PRISMATIC, 2 REVOLUTE, 3 REVOLUTE_UNWRAPPED, 4 SPHERICAL. Each link gets a default box collision shape ([param box_half_extents]); mass properties derive from it at [param density]. Replace the shape with [method articulation_set_link_shape].

method.name: articulation_set_drive
method.description: Unlocks [param axis] on the link's inbound joint and configures a PD drive toward [param drive_target] at [param drive_velocity]. Axes: 0 TWIST, 1 SWING1, 2 SWING2, 3 X, 4 Y, 5 Z. [param drive_type]: 0 FORCE, 1 ACCELERATION.

method.name: articulation_set_limit
method.description: Unlocks [param axis] and clamps it to [code][low, high][/code] with a joint limit.

method.name: articulation_set_fix_base
method.description: Fixes the base link in place (robot/anchored chains). Set before [method articulation_set_space].

method.name: articulation_get_link_transform
method.description: Returns the link's world-space pose (poll for rendering).

method.name: articulation_is_sleeping
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the articulation is asleep.

method.name: articulation_set_link_shape
method.description: Replaces the link's collision shape with a per-link instance of the shared shape [param shape] (created by the shape_create methods), placed at [param transform]. Convex polygon shapes preserve mirroring; concave shapes degrade to query-only on links (they simulate — REG-0014 semantics). Mass properties are recomputed at the link's stored density.

method.name: articulation_set_link_collision_layer
method.description: Sets the link shape's collision layer (Redot "what I am" bits, filter word0).

method.name: articulation_set_link_collision_mask
method.description: Sets the link shape's collision mask (Redot "what I collide with" bits, filter word1).

method.name: articulation_get_link_collision_layer
method.description: Returns the link shape's collision layer.

method.name: articulation_get_link_collision_mask
method.description: Returns the link shape's collision mask.

method.name: articulation_get_link_velocity
method.description: Returns the link's world velocity as [code]{ "linear": Vector3, "angular": Vector3 }[/code] (empty when the index is invalid).
